"5102 Transsøfofagal ekko." is a specific medical procedure code used within the Danish healthcare system to identify transesophageal echocardiography. It is one of the registered procedure codes in the [[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]] (National Health Service Register) [^src1]. This code plays a critical role in the national quality measurement efforts for patients with atrial fibrillation, as coordinated by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to ensure standardized data collection and comparison across Danish regions [^src1].

In the context of clinical quality indicators for atrial fibrillation, [[ekkokardiografi|echocardiography]] is a key diagnostic and monitoring tool. The specific procedure of transesophageal echocardiography is formally coded as "5102 Transsøfofagal ekko." in the registry [^src2]. This code is part of a broader set of echocardiography codes tracked in the Sygesikringsregisteret, which also includes [[2208-ekkocardiografi|2208 Ekkocardiografi]], [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse]], [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse]], [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]], [[5103-stress-ekkocardiogra|5103 Stress ekkocardiogra]], [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]], [[6408-ekkocardiografi|6408 Ekkocardiografi]], and [[0906-ekko-kardiografi|0906 Ekko-kardiografi]] [^src1]. These codes are utilized to calculate denominators, numerators, and exclusion criteria for national quality indicators, functioning as a technical reference for implementing evidence-based clinical standards in the Danish healthcare system [^src3].
